$description: Cucusa brand typography v2 — Archivo for display, JetBrains Mono for reading sizes. Three surface-specific scales, fixed in px because each surface is designed once and only ever scales down. Playground values: not consumed by tokens/ yet.

display.$description: Display face. Variable width 62–125 and weight 100–900. Loaded from Google Fonts in the canvas; needs self-hosting before it enters tokens/.

text.$description: Text face, kept as the engineering signature. Body, labels, code, numbers, axes. Never above the H2 step.

scale.$description: Sizes are px on the design canvas. 'screen' is the approximate size once the platform scales the artwork.

post.$description: LinkedIn post, 1080×1350. Phone shows it at ~×0.33. Label 36px is the floor: 12px on screen.

display.$description: Archivo 800, leading 0.95, tracking -0.03em. One statement, 2–5 words. ~48px on screen.

h1.$description: Archivo 800, leading 1.00, tracking -0.025em. Post headline, ≤3 lines, ≤17 chars per line. ~35px on screen.

h2.$description: Archivo 700, leading 1.10, tracking -0.02em. Second thought, section title. ~24px on screen.

lead.$description: Archivo 500, leading 1.25, tracking -0.01em. Subtitle, attribution. ~19px on screen.

body.$description: JetBrains Mono 400, leading 1.40. Explanations, table cells, ≤35 chars per line. ~15px on screen.

label.$description: JetBrains Mono 500 caps, leading 1.20, tracking +0.08em. Eyebrows, tags, axes. The floor: ~12px on screen.

web.$description: Blog and portfolio: the same hierarchy re-based on an 18px body, where the reader controls zoom.

banner.$description: LinkedIn profile banner, 1584×396. Desktop top card shows it at ~804px (×0.51), phone at ~393px (×0.25). The headline carries the message alone; everything else is texture on a phone.

headline.$description: Archivo 800, width 85%, leading 1.02, tracking -0.02em. Two hand-broken lines in a 980–1080px column. ~32px on desktop.

roles.$description: JetBrains Mono 500, leading 1.2, sand-light on navy. ~15px on desktop.

footer.$description: JetBrains Mono 400, slate-light on navy. Under a rule on the 288px grid line, 14px below it, ~50px of air to the edge. ~13px on desktop.

banner.$description: Geometry measured from the live profile, in banner px.

photo.$description: Profile photo diameter at banner scale (168px on the 804px top card), placed 60px from the left, 190px from the top, overlapping the bottom edge.

copy-start.$description: Left edge of the copy column when the photo is in place; 560px when it is not.

copy-end.$description: Right edge of the copy column. Phones crop the sides.

grid.$description: Background rule grid pitch, in rule-navy.
